patch_description: Replace the second identical XX matching with a complementary ring-shifted matching. The current circuit decomposes into four isolated qubit pairs, so repeating the same edges adds local depth but no broader information flow. Connecting [1,2], [3,4], [5,6], and [7,0] in the second echo links all eight qubits into a ring while preserving the same gate count, parallel depth, and single shared parameter. This should retain perfect accuracy and parameter economy while potentially improving loss and convergence.
